Start date: 1826-02-23  
Subtract 10 weeks = 70 days → 70 + 3 days = 73 days earlier.  
1826 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
February has 28 days in 1826.  

Back up:  
From 1826-02-23, subtract 23 days → 1826-01-31.  
Remaining 73 − 23 = 50 days.  
From 1826-01-31, subtract 31 days → 1825-12-31.  
Remaining 50 − 31 = 19 days earlier in December 1825.  
31 − 19 = 12 → 1825-12-12.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1825-12-12
